topics.title: Stern Discusses Ratings Decline
topics.summary: During a Hollywood radio roundtable, Howard Stern and co-hosts discuss their station’s declining ratings. They attribute the issue to competition from a zookeeper program in Philadelphia, blaming special programming and attributing failures to an absent employee named cope.”}id: 1234567890

topics.title: Stern Criticizes Philadelphia Ratings & Listener Loyalty
topics.summary: Howard Stern repeatedly expresses frustration with the zookeeper in Philly and his low ratings. He criticizes listeners’ loyalty to the station, questions the accuracy of rating systems, and engages in absurd storytelling about shooting people and comparing himself to other radio personalities – ultimately suggesting a lack of awareness among listeners.”} ief summary: Howard Stern rants about Philadelphia's poor ratings, listener loyalty, and questionable music choices while weaving bizarre stories. 53 words.

topics.title: Stern Attacks Biden and College Lies
topics.summary: Howard Stern criticizes Joe Biden’s claims about his law school performance—specifically alleging he fabricated a top-half ranking and plagiarized—and urges listeners to vote in the primary election, advocating for a candidate other than Biden.

topics.title: Ratings, Tyson’s Mother-in-Law & A Musician's Struggle
topics.summary: Howard discusses ratings and Keith’s performance issues before abruptly shifting to a lawsuit involving Dave Winfield accused of transmitting an STD to Mike Tyson’s mother-in-law. The conversation then pivots to Donnie Osman, a struggling musician in London seeking recognition.

topics.title: Celebrity Scandals & Witchcraft Claims
topics.summary: The broadcast features discussions of witchcraft accusations involving Jane Mansfield’s death through Anton Bevaig's spellwork, Reverend Bob Larson exposing alleged Satanist stars like Keith Emerson and Phil Collins, and revelations about baby sacrifices. A stage altercation with Donnie Osman is also discussed alongside claims regarding a Tokyo woman’s psychic abilities and musical celebrity news.

topics.title: Stern’s Pasta Predicament & Siobhan’s Absurdity
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio segment, Howard Stern attempts to promote his friend Jerry’s comedy club and Grandpa Lewis’ pasta restaurant while engaging in bizarre conversations with the delusional Grandpa Lewis and the perplexing woman named Siobhan who claims seven languages. The conversation devolves into nonsensical tangents involving fabricated jobs, personal anxieties, and an increasingly absurd attempt at convincing Siobhan she resembles a man.
